title: One Small Engineering project configuration
description: Version 1. Lives at .github/one-small-engineering.json in a project repository. It confirms which registry project the repository is and tunes reporting. It cannot choose the mapping: the hub's registry decides which repository belongs to which project, and a mismatching projectId fails closed. Every reporting key is optional; the hub defaults apply when it is absent.

enabled.description: false pauses sync for this project without removing it.

workflows.description: Workflow file names whose default-branch conclusions are recorded. Empty or absent records every workflow that ran on the default-branch head.

releaseTagPattern.description: Regular expression with one capture group holding the semantic version.

evidenceLabel.description: A merged PR with this label is recorded as evidence.

materialPaths.description: Globs. A merged PR touching any of these paths is recorded as evidence.
